messages.message: Explain how you would prepare a synchronization plan for Quartz Sync.
For quartz syncs you must show the exact source and destination and say if overwrite can happen before any command.
Use sample paths only; do not perform the synchronization.
Now consider a generated local preview that can be recreated.
Describe the containment checks for that preview directory.
For a generated Quartz preview only, a read-only dry run can skip making a backup, but it still has to show both paths.
Keep the preview exception limited to that disposable context.
